entries.af6ef6bd07f56e2d: Pickled Vegetable Manufacturing and Sales Business
entries.c040870857587122: A holding company in Tokorozawa, Saitama Prefecture, with under its umbrella pickle manufacturers that make light pickles, kimchi and prepared dishes.
entries.c9d9b5c936e222f3: This is a single segment consisting solely of the pickled vegetable manufacturing and sales business, whose main operations are the manufacture and sale of lightly pickled vegetables and prepared foods, as well as the sale of pickled vegetables and other products. The company is a holding company that performs management of subsidiaries and related incidental operations; the group consists of the company, 14 subsidiaries and 3 affiliates. Consolidated number of employees is 411 (as of February 28, 2026).
entries.e1c2562888c2ecca: These are products manufactured by the group, such as lightly pickled vegetables, kimchi and prepared foods. The representative product is the kimchi "Gohan ga Susumu Kimuchi" (Kimchi That Makes Rice Go Down), characterized by the sweetness of apple and the savory taste of seafood. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥28,923 million.
